capabilities: Index the vault's Markdown notes locally
Answer natural-language questions in a chat view with citations to source notes
Filter searches by exact phrase, tag, extension, path, and exclusions
Rerank results with local embedding models
Rebuild the full vault index on demand
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a graph-view or visualization tool; its job is local AI chat and semantic search over note contents.
extras: Requires manual installation (no marketplace listing described); chat and semantic search fail without a running Ollama server, though the UI still opens. README includes third-party license list.
problem: Obsidian's search is keyword-based and can't answer natural-language questions or rank passages semantically without sending notes to a cloud service.
summary: Local AI search-and-chat plugin that indexes vault Markdown and answers questions with cited notes via a self-hosted Ollama server.
